items.question: What exactly do you build for us?
items.answer: Event-driven workflows that automate high-volume operational processes – lead capture and routing, returns management, order status inquiries, payment verification, inventory alerts, approval workflows, multi-channel content distribution, and showing scheduling. If your team handles it repeatedly and it follows business logic, we can automate it with seamless human handoff when judgment is required.

items.question: What industries get the most value from Acme?
items.answer:
We focus on three core industries:

eCommerce & Retail: Returns management, inventory alerts, order tracking, payment reconciliation

Marketing Agencies & Teams: Lead capture and qualification, campaign execution, multi-channel distribution, CRM workflows

Real Estate: Inquiry response, showing scheduling, listing alerts, client reminders

These industries have high-volume, repetitive processes where event-driven automation delivers immediate, measurable ROI. However, our cognitive AI platform isn’t limited to these verticals – any business with workflow automation needs, customer service operations, or multi-system coordination can benefit from unified automation.

items.question: What types of business processes can you automate?
items.answer: Our cognitive AI platform handles business workflow automation across customer support, sales operations, marketing campaigns, inventory management, payment reconciliation, order processing, and lead qualification. AI agents manage conversational interfaces (chat and voice), trigger backend workflows, and escalate complex situations to human team members when needed – all on one unified platform.

items.question: Can multiple AI agents work together in our organization?
items.answer: Yes. Our cognitive AI platform supports a multi-agent architecture where different cognitive AI agents collaborate within unified workflows. Agents share context automatically, transfer conversations intelligently when needed, and coordinate complex multi-department processes. Unlike solutions requiring separate platforms, our event-driven system enables seamless agent cooperation across your entire organization.

items.question: Can we customize the AI agents’ voices and personalities?
items.answer: Yes, our conversational voice AI allows complete customization of AI agents’ voices, speaking styles, and personalities to match your brand. You can choose from multiple voice options or create custom voices that align with your company’s identity and communication style.

items.question: How accurate is the voice recognition capability?
items.answer: Our conversational voice AI employs advanced voice recognition technology that delivers high accuracy across different accents and speaking styles. Cognitive AI agents built on our platform understand natural speech patterns, industry-specific terminology, and handle background noise effectively while maintaining rapid response times for natural conversation flow.

items.question: Do I need technical skills to use Acme?
items.answer: Not to get started. You provide process knowledge; we show you how to build it. Through collaborative creation, you gain the skills to manage your automation independently without ongoing technical help.

items.question: Do you offer a free trial or self-service signup?
items.answer: Yes, signup is self-serve, no card and no sales call needed. Every account starts with 5,000 free credits and full access to the canvas, all AI features, and 2,700+ integrations. There’s no monthly fee and no expiry; pay as you go from $10 when you launch, with human chat support unlocking on your first purchase.

items.question: How quickly can we deploy automation with Acme?
items.answer: With professional onboarding included, most businesses reach production up towithin 2-3 weeks. Our team helps you configure cognitive AI agents, build event-driven workflows, and integrate with your existing systems. Using pre-built templates for common use cases (returns management, lead capture, order tracking), we can deploy working automation in your first onboarding session.

items.question: What’s included in professional onboarding?
items.answer: Every plan includes 10-20 hours of hands-on guided setup. We build your automation together – you learn while creating so you can manage, modify, and improve independently after launch. You walk away with working automation and the knowledge to control it yourself.

items.question: How do your AI agents handle situations requiring human judgment?
items.answer: This is our core differentiator. Our cognitive AI platform is the only solution that combines automation and humans in an organic way. Event-driven workflows handle routine processes automatically, then hand off seamlessly to your team when situations require judgment, creativity, or relationship management. After human resolution, automation resumes without awkward breaks or system switching.

items.question: How does event-driven automation differ from traditional workflow builders?
items.answer: Traditional workflow builders force you to draw rigid flowcharts that break when business conditions change. Our cognitive AI platform uses an event-driven architecture that responds to real business triggers – inventory changes, customer requests, and system updates. When complexity requires human judgment, workflows hand off seamlessly to your team, then resume automation automatically. This is the only platform where business workflow automation and human expertise work organically as one.

items.question: What makes Acme different from Zapier or other workflow builders?
items.answer: Unlike traditional builders that give you a canvas and say “good luck,” we provide event-driven architecture that adapts to real business complexity. Key differentiators: professional onboarding included (10-20 hours), conversational interfaces native to workflows (not separate tools), voice support with one click, unlimited seats at Teams tier, and transparent ROI with published time equivalents.

items.question: What happens after workflows go live?
items.answer: You choose your support model. Many operations managers prefer self-service – monitoring dashboards, making adjustments, and adding processes independently. Others prefer ongoing expert involvement available through the Enterprise tier for workflow optimization, new integration setup, and strategic automation planning. Either approach works.

items.question: What kind of support do you provide?
items.answer: All plans include technical assistance during onboarding plus ongoing support for workflow optimization, integration troubleshooting, and system configuration. Enterprise customers receive dedicated success management, SLA guarantees, human workflow review services, and priority response. Our team helps ensure your business workflow automation delivers measurable results.

items.question: Can we use voice and chat on the same workflows?
items.answer: Yes. Conversational interfaces – both text and voice – live natively inside workflows on our cognitive AI platform. Your existing workflow configurations work across every channel automatically. Add voice support with a single click; no rebuilding required. This unified approach eliminates the need to stitch separate chatbot, voice AI, and automation tools together.

items.question: Can your cognitive AI platform integrate with our existing systems?
items.answer: Yes, our cognitive AI platform integrates with over 2,700 business tools, including CRM systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive), eCommerce platforms (Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento), ERP systems, ticketing platforms, and communication tools. Cognitive AI agents access and update these systems automatically through event-driven workflows, eliminating manual data entry and synchronization failures.

items.question: How do you handle security and compliance?
items.answer: Our cognitive AI platform includes enterprise-grade security with data encryption, role-based access controls, and audit logging. For regulated industries, Enterprise plans offer enhanced security features, compliance documentation, and dedicated security reviews. All cognitive AI agents operate within your security policies and integration permissions.

items.question: What business systems does Acme integrate with?
items.answer: Over 2,700 tools, including CRMs (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive), eCommerce platforms (Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento), ERPs (Odoo, NetSuite), support systems (Zendesk, Intercom), communication tools (Slack, email, SMS), calendars, spreadsheets, and payment processors. If you use it, we likely integrate with it.
